Discounts are automatically applied to stays, no promo codes needed. The total price already includes your savings.

Welcome to Wendell's Place!" This luxurious open-concept beach home is brand new to the rental market and boasts access to Lake Powell, use of the community pool, fenced back yard, 4 beach chairs for your use, is within walking distance to the shops & restaurants of 30 Avenue, and is only a quick bike ride to the Town Center of Rosemary Beach! All of this, while staying only a 3-minutes away from the beautiful beaches of the Emerald Coast! This large coastal home features an open concept family-friendly open floor plan, 1st floor master suite, a well-appointed gourmet kitchen, private lanai, a fenced-in backyard, 3 additional guest bedrooms, and a third floor loft. The home was set up with your comfort in mind, with ample seating in the family room, a large dining table with seating for 8, additional seating for 4 at the large kitchen island, and a second living area on the home's third floor. Your family is sure to love all the space this home offers with multiple living areas, private balconies, and the homes screened lanai.



During your stay at "Wendell's Place," you will be able to enjoy all this beautiful home has to offer, as well as take advantage of accessing Lake Powell from the community private dock! Experience the fun of paddle boarding, kayaking, or fishing on one of 30A's world-famous Dune Lakes! Hot from a long day in the sun?? Inlet Beach & 30A's surrounding areas have you covered with their many wonderful restaurants, shops, and miles and miles of bike paths up and down Scenic 30A. Your next unforgettable family vacation starts here!



Each reservation of this property includes a credit to be used towards beach gear rentals and services at La Dolce Vita. This includes bikes, paddle boards, kayaks, tours/experiences, and could even be used towards a beach bonfire for the entire family!

After just one stay in this amazing beach house, you will know that you have found your annual family vacation destination for years to come!



Amenities:

- Beach Access is only a 4 minute bike ride or drive away.

- 4 Free beach chairs in the lanai for your use

- Community Pool

- Spacious open floor plan

- Screened Lanai

- 3 Designated parking spaces in driveway

- Gourmet Kitchen

- Community Dock with access to lake Powell.

- Fenced in Back yard

- Outdoor dining table and chairs



Starter Amenity Package:



All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.







SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.





FAQ's

*Distance to the beach? Short golf cart ride or bike ride away (3-4 minute golf cart or bike ride)

*Distance to Community Pool? The community pool is just around the corner from the home.

*Pool heated? No

*Grill on site? Yes

*Parking spots? 3 designated parking spots. 3 parking spots in the driveway of the home. Driveway will accommodate 3 cars depending on size. Over flow parking available at the community pool on a 1st come 1st serve basis.

*Amenities provided? Yes, amenity starter pack in the unit (paper towels/trash bags (1 per trash can)/sponge/hand soap/dishwasher pod/dish soap/laundry pod/conditioning shampoo/body wash)
